obligations.detail: ProductionContactF04DerivativeAuthority has no proof constructor. M05 (fixed-L regularized energy identity) is now compiled, which is the prerequisite; moving-aperture differentiation of the prime staircase cells, the pole upper endpoint and the singular regularized arch integral (locally uniform domination near t=0) remains to be proved.
conditional two-scalar stationary contact theorem not formalized in this campaign.
closed form int_0^inf e^{-t/2} S_K(t/L) dt = (8/L)(uu^T - a^2 vv^T) verified numerically to 5e-29 (falsifier F07); Lean proof (improper oscillatory integrals) not attempted.
B_L(t)=B(t) and D(t)=4 sinh(t/2)-B(t) reexpression of the pole-prime discrepancy not formalized here.
fixed-K compressed C6/C8 operator gluing and one-sided order-7/9 jumps not formalized; existing merged authority remains C2.
third-order Schur formula s''' = a''' - 6 Re(b'^T R b'') + 6 b'^T R H' R b' not formalized.
zero-endpoint summation-by-parts identity and the F04-conditional contact-weighted balance not formalized.
operator O(h^9) perturbation and resolvent/Schur comparison not proved; ContactNinthJumpGapBound takes the jump formula as an explicit premise.

StrictEvenPrimeSeamDichotomy compiles the abstract LOW/HIGH classification from explicit degree-9 expansion premises; real analyticity of the actual frozen canonical branch and the same-zero-mode continuation are not proved.
fresh-born, odd, tied, interior branches untouched.
moving-vector rational asymptotics are exact SymPy/mpmath controls only; small-omega indefiniteness is not a Lean theorem.

Exact inertia is Lean-compiled at omega=1/2 for every K>=2 (SourceParityExactInertia). The strict signed-minor (Andreief) lemma for 0<omega<1/2 is OPEN; F06 samples omega in {0.05,0.25,1/3,0.45} for K<=9 and leading-minor signs at a in {2pi*0.05, pi/2, pi}.
filtered carriers (1-cos)^s Q and sin(1-cos)^s Q: the shift-operator proof extends (form = +-<q,(1-J^2)^s R q>), but the filtered-carrier dimension identification is not formalized.
counting-with-multiplicity zero-level passages on (1/2,1) not formalized; F08 grid discovery shows passages are generally NOT monotone (more change points than the lower bound for K>=4).
the premise delta*||Dz||^2 <= B*|M4(z)| is not derived from the contact structure here; only the index-mass inequality and the conditional algebra are compiled.
